title: Direct-from-primitives zero-proximal 28-run convergence record
description: Self-contained, plot-ready convergence trajectories for the 28-branch direct zero-proximal Gauss--Seidel control experiment.

source_experiment.path_note: Paths are historical archive-relative provenance paths. All quantities needed for convergence plots are embedded here.

acceptance.criterion: one-start common frozen-profile maximum relative gain <= 1%, all six solves successful
acceptance.claim_scope: Local one-start computational 1%-equilibrium criterion; not a global Nash certificate or fixed-point convergence proof.

accounting.interpretation: One intermediate profile passed the audit at sweep 10, but no branch established sustained fixed-point convergence.

methodological_assessment.clean_stage1_assisted_result: 0.6214% candidate generated at fixed alpha 0.30 without move caps or player freezing
methodological_assessment.direct_control_result: 1 of 28 branches passed the local one-start 1% criterion
methodological_assessment.exploratory_four: valid frozen audits, but generated with tuned price transformations, selective player updates, and effective weights below 0.30
methodological_assessment.recommended_confirmation: matched primitive-capacity versus Stage-1-capacity cost-price starts under identical fixed alpha>=0.30, no caps/freezing, and 80 sweeps
